title: Eventual vanishing of a stage section in the supplied cocone
statement: For the data of the finite-site section comparison theorem, if a stage element x has zero image under K.ι, then some refinement map D.map b sends x to zero.

source.place: Tag 0A35, stage section presentation and equality paragraphs; abelian extension via sites-modules.tex Tag 03CO

proof.text: Construct the raw abelian presheaf diagram B, its Kan units beta and the compatible comparison gamma from the supplied alpha and theta. The imported raw-diagram theorem is proved by explicit leftKanExtension, descOfIsLeftKanExtension, stage-adjunction injectivity and Kan hom_ext. It needs no object/arrow colimit or finite-cover hypothesis.
Apply the independent raw-abelian sheaf-condition statement to B. This uses finite covers and preserved covering pullbacks; it makes no assertion about the canonical inverse image.

For each stage, compose the two sheaf adjunctions and use leftAdjointUniq to identify the adjunct of alpha with the composite inverse-image isomorphism: h-alpha identifies its transpose with the original unit. Kan uniqueness identifies gamma with the corresponding raw comparison. Hence sheafification of gamma is an isomorphism. On the connected category Under i the colimit of these isomorphisms to the same target is an isomorphism, by the constant-cocone universal property. Since colimit B and the target are sheaves, their sheafification units are isomorphisms; naturality cancels these to prove the actual raw colimit comparison phi is an isomorphism. These two arguments are fully proved in private helpers raw_comparison_iso and raw_colimit_comparison_iso.

Use raw abelian evaluation to obtain a colimit cocone R on the supplied D and its evaluation isomorphism q, with the formula for its legs followed by phi. Arrow.mk_injective applied to hK and that formula identifies K_t followed by e with R_t followed by q and phi. Apply the zero hypothesis and map_zero to this composite. Cancel the isomorphism q followed by phi to get R_t(x)=R_t(0). The forgetful functor on abelian groups preserves filtered colimits. Apply the same-stage filtered-set equality criterion to its image of R, obtaining one b with D(b)(x)=D(b)(0); map_zero concludes D(b)(x)=0. No inverse-image zero-detection or parent comparison is imported.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A35 independent raw Kan-extension construction and adjunction identification; abelian adaptation via Tag 03CO. M2 compiled reduction: two independent raw computations left, diagram construction and complete adjunction/cancellation/filtered-zero argument proved.

theorem colimit_site_finite_section_eventual_zero
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
          t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (K : Cocone D) (e : K.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
      i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hK : ∀ t : Under i, Arrow.mk (K.ι.app t ≫ e.hom) =
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))))
    (hD : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫ (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom)) :
    ∀ (t : Under i) (x : D.obj t), (K.ι.app t).hom x = 0 →
      ∃ (t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'), (D.map b).hom x = 0
